test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options is INCORRECTLY paired?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Guavas - Telangana.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The list of state fruits with their state is given:
 
 
• **Apples - Himachal Pradesh**
 
• **Oranges - Nagpur**
 
• **Banana - Kerala**
 
• **Mango - Telangana**
 
 

**Hence the Guavas - Telangana is incorrectly matched.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **The jackfruit was declared Kerala's official fruit on 21st March 2018.**
